gap_2_discharge_readiness_wiring.status: NOT CLOSED - requires new clinical content
gap_2_discharge_readiness_wiring.audit: Of the five functional discharge criteria (haemodynamically_stable, pain_controlled_on_oral_regimen, tolerating_oral_intake, no_significant_persistent_vomiting, mobile), NONE can be evaluated from an existing approved patient state: (1) the approved TRJ-POSTOP-RECOVERY model's transitions set ONLY symptoms.postopPainStage and truth.recoveryPhase, both advanced purely by elapsed-time milestone gates (eligible_after_minutes), with no learner-action condition; (2) recovery_domains / domain_focus are attention cues, not satisfied-state assertions; (3) the discharge_readiness_contract explicitly says window_end_effect: expectation_only_never_override and 'MUST NOT set any discharge criterion to met ... merely because time passed'; (4) postop.oralIntake records the learner's ORDER, not tolerance; symptoms.nausea/vomitingEpisodes are the pre-operative presentation, never updated post-op; there is no mobilisation state and no approved haemodynamic-stability threshold (threshold: null NEEDS_CLINICAL_REVIEW).
gap_2_discharge_readiness_wiring.conclusion: Wiring any of the five would require inventing a threshold / oral-intake amount / mobilisation criterion / postoperative nausea-vomiting state, or treating a time-only phase as a discharge trigger - all explicitly forbidden. The five criteria remain emitted as unmet 'discharge_runtime_fact' simulator limitations (honest), not hidden.
missing_clinical_content: postoperative haemodynamic/respiratory stability state or criterion-satisfying rule (no approved threshold exists)
postoperative oral-intake tolerance state (only the learner's order is recorded today)
postoperative nausea/vomiting recovery state (current nausea/vomiting is pre-operative presentation only)
postoperative mobilisation state (not modelled at all)

for pain_controlled_on_oral_regimen: a reviewed decision either that postopPainStage == controlled_on_oral_analgesia may satisfy the criterion despite being purely time-driven (conflicts with the current approved expectation_only_never_override contract), or a reviewed mechanism tying postopPainStage progression to learner reassessment/analgesia rather than elapsed time alone
